I support and cherish all people who played the OG PUBG during the summer of 2018. For it was the best time anybody could've experienced this game, and this is not just some old-school novelty nostalgia. At its current state, the game has been overrun by mountains of over-saturated content in update race wars with Fortnite, Apex, Warzone, and many more. It's not the developer's fault for adding in things, but rather a distasteful fact. The fact that this game does not respect your time, and you shouldn't either. For every new shiny toy, a skin, a season, and a questionable gameplay decision added in, it is another moment to reflect and reconsider playing this game by yourself or with friends. Games are art, meant to evoke interest, curiosity, and most important of all, fun. This is not a game, this is a sellout money-making machine.

Highly recommended with a few, but key technical solutions:
1) Renodx is a must for anyone playing in HDR. Raised blacks levels make having an OLED screen pointless otherwise. 
2) Traversal stutter is awful with this game, use this mod to fix it https://www.nexusmods.com/silenthill2/mods/111?tab=description
3) VRR flicker ruins the experience, use DLSS 4.5 performance or ultra performance and disable framegen to enjoy a tlicker-free experience. 

After this it was an experience worth remembering free of distractions.

Somber Echoes is a hidden gem in the metroidvania genre that offers some very fun and fluid movement paired with exceptional visuals. The story combines greek mythology, a little bit of family drama and some backstabbing on the side.
Puzzles and platforming are very enjoyable and don't overcomplicate things. 
Gametime clocked in a little under 7 hours for 100% completion, so a a bit on the shorter side.
The game is relatively easy, not counting the optional 1 hit challenges for bosses (which are also not needed for achievements)
With that being said, I would still recommend the game, especially to all metroidvania fans. Everyone else can check out the free demo to get a better picture of Somber Echoes.

A extremely weird and often quite funny noir adventure game where you are a anthropomorphic cat P.I. trying to solve the murder of a very weird and tiny cat that looks exactly like you.... That's the setup, then it gets weirder. A lot weirder. Plays with noir movie stereotypes and tropes and doesn't overstay it's welcome with a fairly tight script with little fluff.

It's mostly a visual novel where you can move around in the areas, not really any puzzles to speak about or any detective work. A very solid game, and right now at a excellent price during the sale. 

Completion was mostly following the story, I don't think there are any missable ones (at least not if you do what the game tell you to do and not rush forward.)
2344+ hours of replayability PLUS workshop characters and items and quality of life stuff makes this game endless fun

Is Paladins a fun and good game? Yes it is!
Is Overwatch better than this game? WHO CARES?!
It doesn't matter which game is better. Both Overwatch and Paladins are good games and are genuinely fun to play. I admit Overwatch has a lot more polish on its content, but that's mainly because Blizzard clearly has a much bigger budget. I was just sick and tired of people saying Overwatch is the best game ever and nothing else matters. My point is that Paladins IS a fun game and I would recommend playing it; even if you have Overwatch. I'm not saying which game is better, mainly that's down to personal perspective.

Not gonna lie, I only picked this up because it was blowing up all over social media and I wanted to see if it was actually worth the hype.. mostly because I’m a bit of a hater when things get too popular.
Yeah. I was wrong.
This game hit me way harder than I expected. The story? Beautiful. The music? Absolutely stunning. And the scenery? Just breathtaking. I didn’t think I’d get this emotional over it, but here we are.

If you’re on the fence or just curious like I was.. yes, it’s really that good.
Coming from someone who never writes reviews, this one earned it.
